scientific_integrity: The global dynamics are proved analytically; finite exact-arithmetic and numerical tests serve only as independently executable consistency checks. Literature comparisons are limited to the sources genuinely inspected. No independent audit or external mathematical validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The deterministic theorem concerns only two equally sized patches with symmetric repeated exchange and a rational saturating infection update. It does not assert an analogous phenomenon for the full four-compartment SEIRS source model, stochastic epidemics, or unequal patch populations.
title: A finite-mixing parity threshold for global extinction in a two-patch saturation model
